Using the old product name

This lesson still calls the product Example Images, which is the one retired-term finding in its prose.

The examplectl tool can compare two containers with its images diff subcommand. Those are two code elements, and read together they are not the retired command.

List what the registry holds. The command was renamed, and this term opts in to code.

$ examplectl images list

Verify the signature. The identity is the organisation that signed the artifact, so it must keep its old name, and nothing here reports it.

$ cosign verify --certificate-identity=https://github.com/example-images/images/.github/workflows/release.yaml@refs/heads/main registry.example.com/example/app
